doc.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022

title: Club pay then and now
summary: A small gig paid about a hundred dollars in 1987 and club pay has since gone down.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What is the average — when you were playing that gig at The Garage do you mind asking me what you were getting paid?

Oh, I don’t want to tell you, but I will tell you that it wasn’t a lot but it was a good enough to get great musicians to do it. So I mean when I first moved to New York, to get © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
a little gig like that paid a hundred bucks, that was a pretty good gig, and that’s still the case.
Yeah. Talk about the clubs — I think if anything they’ve gone down, down, down.
Yeah, no inflation going on there with those prices.
